mapper.select: select fa.file_name, (SELECT DISTINCT (fe. NAME) FROM sys_user_allocation sua, fnd_employee_assigns fea, fnd_employee fe WHERE fa.created_by = sua.user_id AND sua.employee_assign_id = fea.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID AND fe.EMPLOYEE_ID = fea.EMPLOYEE_ID) upload_person, fa.creation_date upload_date FROM fnd_atm_attachment fa, fnd_atm_attachment_multi fam WHERE fam.table_name = 'HLS_BP_ATTACHMENT' and fa.attachment_id = fam.attachment_id and fam.table_pk_value = #{tablePkValue} order by fam.last_update_date desc

SELECT hba.*, sfs.FILE_NAME, sfs.file_id, sfs.UPLOAD_DATE, sfs.FILE_SIZE, nvl( ( SELECT su.DESCRIPTION FROM sys_user su WHERE su.USER_ID = hba.CREATED_BY ), '' ) AS upload_person FROM hls_bp_attachment hba, ( SELECT sf.file_id, sf.FILE_NAME, sf.UPLOAD_DATE, sf.FILE_SIZE, sf.ATTACHMENT_ID, sa.SOURCE_KEY FROM sys_file sf,sys_attachment sa WHERE sf.ATTACHMENT_ID = sa.ATTACHMENT_ID AND sa.SOURCE_TYPE = #{bpAttachmentCategory,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) sfs where sfs.file_id = hba.document_id and hba.bp_id = #{bpId} AND hba.bp_attachment_category = #{bpAttachmentCategory,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
